resources.string: Idioktisia

© 2025 Primortex. Me epifylaxi pantos dikaiomatos. To Color Picker, symperilamvanomenon onomatos, logotypou, UI kai poron efarmogis, anikei stin Primortex kai den epitrepetai epanaxrisi xoris grafi adeia.
Stoixeia triton meron
To Color Picker einai xeno me texnologies anoiktou kodika. Anerizoyme kai tiroume tis adeies kathe vivliothikis pou xrisimopoioume.
Jetpack Compose Material 3 gia stoixeia UI
CameraX gia ensomatosi kamerας
Coil gia fortosi eikonon
Ktor gia elafry diktiosi
Navigation Compose kai Accompanist Navigation Animation gia ploigisi stin efarmogi
Simeioseis adeias
Oλες oi vivliothikes triton meron paramenoun stin idioktisia ton antistoixon idioktiton. Oi arxikes adeies diatirountai kai anagrafontai gia leptomeri elegxo.
Epexergasia sti syskevi
I deigmatolipsia xromatos ginetai topika. Ta preview tis kamerας kai oi epilegmenes fotografies analyontai mono gia exagogi timon xromatos kai den apostellontai stous server mas.
Adeies kai dedomena

I efarmogi zita prosvasi mono se leitourgies pou apaitountai gia epilogi xromatos, opws kamera kai vivliothiki fotografiwn. Mporite na anakalesete aftes tis adeies opote thelete apo tis rythmiseis syskevis.
I prosvasi stin kamera xrisimopoieitai gia live deigmatolipsia kai den katagrafetai oute apothikevetai apo emas.
I prosvasi se fotografies xrisimopoieitai mono otan epilegete eikona gia deigmatolipsia.
Xrisi diktuou
Ta aitimata diktuou periorizontai se proairetika ypostiriktika dedomena opws onomata paleton i odigous xrisis. Den metafortontai prosopikes eikones i frames kamerας.
An thelete pliros offline empeiria, mporite na afairesete tin prosvasi sto diktuo se epipedo systimatos.
Diatirisi dedomenon
Ta apothikevmena xromata kai paletes paramenoun sti syskevi sas mexri na ta diagrapsete. I ekkatharisi dedomenon efarmogis i apenkatastasi afairei ta apothikevmena stoixeia.
Epikoinonia kai sxolia
An epikoinonisete me ypostirixi, tha xrisimopoiisoume mono tis plirofories pou parexete gia apantisi sto aitima sas.
Apodoxi oron
Me ti xrisi tou Color Picker, symfoneite me aftous tous orous ypiresias. An den symfoneite, diakopste ti xrisi tis efarmogis.
Xrisi efarmogis
To Color Picker parexetai gia prosopiki kai epaggelmatiki anafora xromaton. Eiste ypefthynoi gia ton tropo xrisis tis efarmogis kai ta apotelesmata ton epilogon sas.
Min xrisimopoieite tin efarmogi me tropous pou paraviazoun efarmosteo nomo i kanones.
Min prospatheite na kanete reverse engineering, na paremvete i na kataxrasteite tis ypiresies tis efarmogis.
Pnevmatiki idiotisia
I efarmogi kai olo to sxetiko periexomeno anikei stin Primortex i stous adeiodotes tis. Den epitrepetai antigrafi, tropopoiisi i anadianomi merous tis efarmogis ektos an epitrepetai apo ton nomo.
Periexomeno kai diathesimotita
Mporoume na enimeronoume i na diakoptoume leitourgies opote dipote. To proairetiko online periexomeno parexetai os exei kai mporei na allaxei xoris proeidopoiisi.
Periorismos efthynis
To Color Picker parexetai os exei, xoris egkyiseis opoioudipote typou. Sto metro pou epitrepei o nomos, den efthinomaste gia zimies apo ti xrisi tis efarmogis.
Epikoinonia
An exete erotiseis sxetika me aftous tous orous, epikoinoniste meso tis formas sxolion stin efarmogi.
Griigoros deiktis
Pigaine amesa stin ergasia pou xreiazesai.

Epilogi xromatos apo Live Camera
Anoixe to Live Camera apo to tab Explore i Camera. Stoxeuse me to stauronima, kane pinch gia zoom gia akriveia kai patise to preview tou swatch gia kleidoma.
Rythmise megethos kai schima stauronimatos sto Explore > Settings gia kaliteri akriveia.
Xrisimopoiese stathero krathma i tripod se xamilo fos.
Epilogi xromatos apo fotografia
Epilese Photo Pick, dialexe eikona apo ti galleri kai patise opoudipote sti fotografia gia na pareis deigma xromatos sto simeio auto.
Kane zoom sti fotografia prin patiseis gia na apomonoseis mikres leptomereies.
Xrisimopoiese pisw xoris apothikefsi an theleis mono na elegxeis ena xroma.
Apothikeusi kai epanaxrisi swatch
Meta ti syllipsi xromatos, patise Save gia apothikefsi stin paleta. Kathe apothikevmeno swatch krata HEX, RGB kai HSL times gia antigrafi.
Patise se apothikevmeno swatch gia antigrafi HEX i anoixe leptomereies gia perissoteres morfes.
Paratetameno patima i energeies epexergasias (otan einai diathesimes) gia afairesi xromaton pou den xreiazesai pia.
Sygrisi kai koinopoiisi timon
Anoixe apothikevmeno swatch gia sygrisi morfon dipla-dipla. Xrisimopoiese antigrafi i koinopoiisi gia apostoli timon sta ergaleia sxediasis i anaptyxis sou.
Organosi paleton
Anoixe to tab Palette gia omadopoiisi sxetikon swatch. Anadiataxe i afairese stoixeia oste i paleta na paramenei estiasmeni sto trexon ergo.
